# Persis Leigh

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Persis Leigh features big, clear hazel eyes paired with an English skin tone. Her look is completed by heaps of glossy brown hair.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

## Personality

Persis Leigh possesses an endearing nature that naturally draws the affection of others. Her character is defined by a sweet and winsome demeanor.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)_

## History

Persis Leigh was cared for by her uncle after her parents died. When her uncle fell ill, she refused to leave his side, remaining with him to provide care.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P7](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0007)_
